**The document doesn't give this number.** The key-value retrieval results by position appear only in Figure 7 (p. 6), which is an image. The text and appendix tables don't list per-position accuracies for the key-value task. The full tabulated results in Appendix G (p. 18) cover only multi-document QA.

The text does provide these related facts:

- **Setup:** The key-value experiments use 75, 140, and 300 key-value pairs, with 500 examples each (p. 6).
- **General trend:** GPT-3.5-Turbo, GPT-3.5-Turbo (16K), and MPT-30B-Instruct perform worst when the key-value pair is in the middle of the context (p. 6). Models other than Claude struggle especially with 140 or 300 pairs (p. 6).
- **Worst case:** In the standard setup, the worst-case key-value performance is 45.6% (p. 7). The paper doesn't say which model or position produced it.
- **With the query placed before and after the data:** GPT-3.5-Turbo (16K) reaches perfect accuracy with 300 key-value pairs (p. 7).

To get the value at the 200th position, you'd need to read it off Figure 7 or use the authors' released data (p. 2).
